system.history:
An ordinary person who chooses to help direct others, call emergency services, carry supplies, or point heroes toward someone in danger.

Scene use: Cooperative witness, rescue helper, messenger, or the civilian who keeps a bad situation from becoming worse.
system.personality: Nervous but compassionate. Acts when given a clear, achievable task and remembers heroes who treat civilians with respect.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Choose one location-specific detail and one useful object they happened to have nearby.

system.description: A desperate close shove made to protect another person or create an escape route.
